QA Strategy & Engineering Blueprint: Visitor Management System

1. Test Strategy Summary

Objective: Ensure 100% data integrity, secure PII handling, and strict compliance with the defense-in-depth architecture.

Approach: Shift-left testing with automated contract testing for APIs (Pact), RLS policy verification, and automated PII anonymization validation. Performance testing focuses on sub-2s response latency under simulated load.

Entry Criteria: API contract definitions approved, Mock S3 service available, Auth service configured.

Exit Criteria: 100% pass rate on P1/P2 test cases, all security vulnerabilities (CRITICAL/HIGH) resolved, performance benchmarks met.

2. Detailed Test Cases

TC ID Req ID Scenario Priority Expected Result
TC-001 FR-01 Unique mobile constraint for active visits P0 DB rejects duplicate mobile for active session
TC-002 SEC-01 Verify RLS enforcement on API P0 User cannot access records owned by others
TC-003 SEC-02 S3 Presigned URL expiration P1 Upload fails after URL lifetime

3. Specialized Test Suites

Security & Privacy Testing

  • BOLA/IDOR: Attempt accessing `/api/visitors/{id}` with a token from a different department.
  • PII Anonymization: Verify nightly batch job correctly scrubs DB fields older than 30 days.
  • Token Handling: Verify refresh token rotation and HttpOnly cookie attributes.

Performance & Boundary Testing

  • Constraint Stress: Attempt visit duration > 480 minutes (Expect 400 Bad Request).
  • Chronology: Ensure check_out time cannot be earlier than check_in time (DB Trigger check).
  • SLA Monitoring: Measure 95th percentile response time for `GET /api/reports/export`.

4. Execution Plan

  • ✔ Smoke: Critical paths (Check-in flow, Auth).
  • ✔ Sanity: Emp portal access and notification dispatch.
  • ✔ Regression: Full suite including RLS policy edge cases and audit log integrity.
